reason: Separate original repair admission and impact recommendations from the required but absent patch/check execution caller.
sourceFacts: local-brain-training-plan emits a selected context in its acquire command without executing that command
lcx-automation-repair-lock dispatches acquire, status and release; the compatibility schedule_gate node represents context eligibility, worktree and lease-time checks, not an automation due caller
valid ineligible context is preserved as rejectedPlanningInput with its exact JSON hash and never becomes accepted planningInput or a lease
lcx-change-impact-plan maps changed paths to owners and recommended commands; it does not apply patches or execute those commands

ops/automation/repair-lock-protocol.md declares an external Codex/manual actor that acquires before mutation and releases after verification; no callable repository repair runner was found, but actual authorized external execution remains permitted
the existing host operator writer can publish doctor findings; sibling observations do not prove lease-to-check execution or doctor-to-next-planner feedback

changes.ownerMeaning: The impact-plan owner remains the existing read-only evidence mapper for local_change/local_tests. required_not_implemented refers to repository patch/check execution implementation, not a prohibition or absence claim for actual external Codex/manual execution. Native lease, patch/check, doctor and release receipts from that authorized actor may satisfy the obligations without a new automation runner. Doctor implementation exists, while same-attempt repair publication remains unobserved.
changes.receiptCompatibility: No receipt, node, filter, edge, relation vocabulary or execution state changes; only descriptive implementation status and evidence responsibilities are corrected.

nonEffects: no repair runner or automation creation
no permission, provider, training or protected-memory change
no graph edge removal or feedback waiver
no recommendation promoted to executed check
no normal refusal promoted to acquired lease or repair completion
no persisted business state or historical receipt rewrite
verification: test/lcx-flow-graph.test.ts: keeps repair execution obligations separate from read-only impact recommendations
acceptance: This migration is descriptive only and cannot close the scene. Declared plans or observer-assembled receipts cannot replace actual authorized execution; the existing external Codex/manual actor may satisfy these obligations with native lease, patch/check, doctor and release receipts without a new automation runner. A blocked branch requires the unchanged auditor's actual source-bound refusal and descendant rules; none are waived by this manifest.
